analyzed_vuln.description: In the r_flavor == CIL_LIST branch, the code appends the address of a stack local pointer (`&sub_list`) into the AST list (`cil_list_append(*leaf_expr, CIL_LIST, &sub_list)`) instead of the heap list pointer itself (`sub_list`). This stores a dangling stack address in `item->data`. Later, during teardown (`cil_destroy_validatetrans` -> `cil_list_destroy`), that stale pointer is treated as `struct cil_list *` and dereferenced, causing stack-use-after-return.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger with a validatetrans constraint expression where the right operand is a list (so `r_flavor == CIL_LIST` in `__cil_fill_constraint_leaf_expr`), e.g. input like `(validatetrans l(eq t3(e)))`. Parsing builds `validtrans->str_expr` via `cil_gen_constraint_expr`; the buggy append records a stack address from `__cil_fill_constraint_leaf_expr`. The crash occurs later when destroying the DB/AST, when recursive `cil_list_destroy` follows that corrupted CIL_LIST entry.
